purpose: The preceding paragraph defines stiffness degradation and qualifies the damping assumption. first_draft: Structural degradation is nonlinear and time-varying. A short-window linear approximation keeps the analysis tractable and suitable for online evaluation. The approximation may be inaccurate during brief intervals of rapid property change. It is typically accurate before and after these events and while degradation evolves slowly.

final: A short-window linear approximation is used to keep the analysis of nonlinear and time-varying structural degradation tractable and suitable for online evaluation. The approximation may be inaccurate during brief intervals of rapid property change. It is typically accurate before and after these events and during periods where degradation evolves slowly.
